summary: Implemented the S3 Expires change in botocore. Changes: (1) botocore/endpoint.py: _do_get_response now emits a before-parse.{service_id}.{operation} event (response_dict, operation_model, context) before parsing. (2) botocore/handlers.py: added handle_expires_header (before-parse.s3.*) which stores the raw Expires header in context['s3_expires_string'], and if parse_timestamp fails, logs a warning and removes the Expires header so the operation completes; added add_expires_string_member (after-call.s3.*) which sets parsed['ExpiresString'] to the raw value; both registered in BUILTIN_HANDLERS. Not done: ExpiresString is not added to the S3 service model's members, and no generated docs deprecation notice was added (this botocore version has no response-docs hook; only the handler docstring notes deprecation). Nothing was run or tested; no commit was made.
